tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Find quantum computing lessons in RoRo Academy by topic (for example: superposition, Bell states, Grover's algorithm, error mitigation). Returns titles, summaries, level, length and links. An empty query lists lessons in course order.

query.description: Topic words to look for in lesson titles and summaries.

language.description: Answer language: en (English), tr (Turkish) or ar (Arabic). Use the user's language when it is one of these; default en.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Read one RoRo Academy lesson by its slug: its explanations, formulas and example circuits as text, with a link to open it in the Academy. Quiz answers are never included.

slug.description: The lesson slug, as search_lessons returns it.

language.description: Answer language: en (English), tr (Turkish) or ar (Arabic). Use the user's language when it is one of these; default en.

tools.name: list_learning_tracks
tools.description: List RoRo Academy's learning tracks and their modules with lesson counts — Primer, Foundations, Real hardware, Academic, Applied and Business.

language.description: Answer language: en (English), tr (Turkish) or ar (Arabic). Use the user's language when it is one of these; default en.

tools.name: list_quantum_computers
tools.description: List the quantum computers and simulators RoRo Quantum offers: name, id, qubit count, technology (superconducting, trapped-ion, neutral-atom or simulator), connectivity and current status.

kind.description: Filter: all (default), simulator, or hardware (real quantum processors).

tools.name: about_roro_quantum
tools.description: What RoRo Quantum is and offers — Academy, Console, Lab, RoRo Copilot and the developer API — with links.
